source: VLABench cf588fe60c0c7282174fe979f5913170cfe69017: each task's conditions in VLABench/configs/evaluation/tracks/track_{1,2,3,4,6}_*.json, VLABench/tasks/condition.py and the task series in VLABench/tasks/hierarchical_tasks/primitive/, restated; positions are the ranges of the pinned episode files (world frame, meters; +x the robot's right, +y away from the robot); 'origin' is the object's reference point the check reads; keyed by the evaluator's task name

notes.add_condiment: A kitchen counter: condiment bottles and shakers stand in a row along y on the robot's right (x about +0.15 to +0.21), shakers with a name tag; a pan with a dish sits on the stove on the robot's left (x -0.20 to -0.10, y -0.19 to 0). Add the named condiment, or the one the instruction implies, to the dish: pick it up, carry it over the pan and tip it until its opening is lower than its base. Success, both at once: the condiment's origin above the pan's origin height and horizontally inside the pan, and the condiment tipped past horizontal (its bottom marker higher than its top marker). No gripper condition: keep holding it. The step limit is 300. The demonstrations grasp it from the side, lift it 20 cm, move to 20 cm above the pan and turn the wrist to pour.
notes.insert_flower: Three flowers lie on the table near the robot (y about -0.16 to -0.05), and a vase stands farther out (y 0.14 to 0.26). Insert the named flower, or the one the instruction describes, into the vase. Success: the flower's origin inside the vase's bounding box (the box spanned by the vase's marker points). No gripper condition: holding it there counts. The demonstrations grasp the flower, lift it while turning the gripper level and pointing forward (+y), move above the vase and lower it 20 cm into the vase.
notes.select_book: Books stand side by side on a shelf beyond the table centre (shelf at y 0.24 to 0.36; the books' origins at about z 1.17 to 1.21). Take the named book, or the one the instruction describes, out of the shelf. Success: the book's origin outside the shelf's bounding box (the box spanned by the shelf's marker points). No gripper condition: holding it outside counts. The demonstrations grasp the book from the front with the gripper level and pointing forward (+y), then pull it back toward the robot.
notes.select_chemistry_tube: Test tubes stand in a rack near the table centre (rack at y 0 to 0.20), each with a name tag behind it naming its solution. Take the named solution's tube, or the one the instruction describes, out of the rack. Success: the tube's origin (near its bottom) outside the rack's bounding box (the box spanned by the rack's marker points): lift it until it is clear of the rack. No gripper condition: holding it there counts. The demonstrations grasp the tube from above and lift it.
notes.select_drink: An open fridge stands beyond the table centre (y 0.29 to 0.41) with two drinks inside, side by side (origins at about z 0.83 to 0.87). Take the named drink, or the one the instruction implies, out of the fridge. Success: the drink's origin outside the fridge's bounding box (the box spanned by the fridge's marker points). No gripper condition: holding it outside counts. The demonstrations grasp it from the front with the gripper level and pointing forward (+y), lift it 10 cm and pull it 30 cm back toward the robot.
notes.select_fruit: Fruits and a plate stand on the table. Put the named fruit, or the one the instruction describes, onto the plate. Success: the fruit's origin horizontally within the plate's radius (or the plate's marker box) and between the plate's origin height and 10 cm above it. No gripper condition: holding it there counts. The demonstrations grasp it and place it on the plate.
notes.select_mahjong: Six or seven mahjong tiles are set in a row across the table near the robot (y -0.10 to 0, 7 cm apart), and a placemat lies farther out (y 0.19 to 0.32). Pick up the named tile, or the one the instruction describes, and put it on the placemat: the instruction may only say to pick it up, but the check requires the placemat. Success: the tile's origin horizontally within the placemat and between the placemat's origin height and 10 cm above it. No gripper condition: holding it there counts. The demonstrations grasp it from above and place it on the placemat.
notes.select_painting: Three paintings are displayed in a row across the table (x about -0.4, 0 and +0.4), each with a red round button (4 cm radius) just in front of it toward the robot (y -0.21 to 0.01, z 0.78). Press the button in front of the painting whose style the instruction names or describes. Success: that button's touch sensor reads a contact force between 0.01 and 100 N for more than 10 consecutive physics substeps (1 ms each) and still at the end of a native step, so press down on it and stay on it. Pressing another button neither ends nor fails the episode. The step limit is 100. The demonstrations close the gripper 10 cm above the button and move the end effector down onto the button's centre.
notes.select_poker: Three or four playing cards stand in card holders in a row across the table (y 0 to 0.20; the cards' origins at z 0.83). Pick the named card, or the one the instruction describes, and lift it. Success, both at once: a part of the gripper touches the card and the card's origin is at z 0.90 or higher (lift it out of the holder by at least 7 cm). Keep holding it. The step limit is 100. The demonstrations grasp the card from above and lift it.
notes.select_toy: Toy figures stand on the table with a gift box. Put the named toy, or the one the instruction describes, into the gift box. Success: the toy's origin inside the box's bounding box (the box spanned by the gift box's marker points). No gripper condition: holding it there counts. The demonstrations grasp the toy from above, lift it 30 cm and place it in the box.
notes.select_nth_largest_poker: Three or four playing cards stand in card holders in a row across the table (y 0.20; the cards' origins at z 0.83). Pick the card the instruction ranks (the largest, the n-th largest or the smallest; ranks run 2 to 10, jack, queen, king, ace, ace highest, suits ignored) and lift it. Success, both at once: a part of the gripper touches the card and the card's origin is at z 0.90 or higher (lift it out of the holder by at least 7 cm). Keep holding it. The step limit is 100. The demonstrations grasp the card from above and lift it.
notes.select_unique_type_mahjong: Six or seven mahjong tiles are set in a row across the table near the robot (y -0.10 to 0, 7 cm apart), and a placemat lies farther out (y 0.18 to 0.31). Exactly one tile's suit (characters 'man', bamboo 'sou' or circles 'pin') occurs once; put that tile on the placemat. Success: the tile's origin horizontally within the placemat and between the placemat's origin height and 10 cm above it. No gripper condition: holding it there counts. The demonstrations grasp it from above and place it on the placemat.
